He chooses the most deadly cultivation world available. But before descending, he makes one outrageous request: he wants every cheat ability in existence...

Monsters such as zombies, werewolves, and even banshees do not exist in this world, and somehow, he had the power to create them all.
Just how powerful would the army of the vampire lord be?

returning-to-the-mysterious-era:
Returning to the Mysterious Era features a boy who can time-travel back to the past using old relics. The twist? He’s stuck in the body of the relic’s owner.
After a near-death experience, Cassius unlocks his ability to travel to the past in the body of Li Wei, a member of the Wind Elephant Sect. Li Wei was a coward who lived a life of regrets up until the day the entire Wind Elephant Sect was mu*dered. As Cassius relives Li Wei’s past, he makes different decisions to show Li Wei a different kind of future.
By living out the ups and downs of Li Wei’s life, Cassius is introduced to the world of Covert Martial Arts, ties that run closer than blood, and supernatural forces. Crossing the line between the ordinary and supernatural, he realizes there’s no way back. New friends and enemies slowly integrate into his reality.
Now, he must uncover the secrets of Covert Martial Arts and get stronger to survive.
rise-of-the-white-devil:
I was always alone, throughout my life. People looked at me with disdain because I was an orphan without parents. Constant abuse followed me everywhere. I lost touch with how to interact with others.
With each passing day, I grew more distant from my emotions until I scarcely recognized myself. The warmth of family and friendship felt foreign to me.
In the end, I snapped, and I became what I hated the most... something that wasn't human anymore... something that shouldn't have been born...
That was until I was reincarnated as Lucas Nightstar, granted a second chance at a happy life with a loving family. Now, I would do anything to protect them, live my life to the fullest, and was willing to destroy anyone who dares stand in my way of my newfound peace. Yet...
Little did I know what fate had in store for me.

surviving-the-zombie-apocalypse-with-my-:
Zombies suddenly appear all over the world, spreading rapidly in crowded cities. Within a day, national governments collapse all around the world, leading to chaos worldwide. Law and order vanish, making people fear both zombies and each other. Despite the zombie threat, groups form and fight over the limited resources.
But, amidst all of that, a man named Richard received a system that allows him to summon troops, military equipment, weapons, and vehicles. With his newfound power, he can protect himself, his comrades, his kin, and other survivors from zombies and rival factions.
A rampaging Goliath? Unleash Warthogs, AC-130s, and Apaches in the sky.
Mutant flying zombies? Establish anti-air defenses.
Juggernauts shrugging off small arms? Deploy Abrams tanks and IFVs.
Rival factions raiding? Let them face our might.
sword-king-in-a-womens-world:
Chu Qing transmigrates to a world where women hold all the power. In this matriarchal society, men are judged solely on their looks, while women are expected to provide for their families. Men are only considered eligible for marriage if they have good virtues, while women must possess a house and a car to be considered desirable. Even worse, women who are financially supported by men are accused of being freeloaders, and some women are known to prey on younger men.
As the “school belle,” Chu Qing is frustrated by these rigid social norms. He believes that a man’s true worth comes from inner strength and character, not just physical appearance. With his ability to cultivate immortality, he sets out to prove that men can be powerful and valuable in their own right, challenging the status quo in this matriarchal society!

the-abandoned-prince-with-the-otherworld:
In a single moment, he had lost everything he possessed.
His father had disowned him; he had lost his title as prince, and the nobles he had considered his friends had turned their backs on him. Finally, he had been exiled.
And it was all because of the “Otherworldly Shopping System.”
Still, no one, including Luke, could understand the value of this ability. As hope faded from his heart, it reappeared in the farthest northern region of the Empire, in a freezing cold area.
10,000 cubic metres of water to irrigate the land? You can get it for just three gold coins.
Perhaps he should establish a new farm? 100 high-quality cows for just 200 gold.
Perhaps he wishes to establish a clothing workshop? Building a ready-made structure would only cost 500 gold.
This is his opportunity, the opportunity of Luke, the Light of the Empire. An abandonment worth a world.
the-alphas-forbidden-bite:
Axel Bessario returns to Ashveil Pack after fourteen months away, carrying a silence heavier than any wound. He expects unrest but not the storm waiting for him. A hostile pack threatens the southern border, ancient enemies stir in the east, and his people are barely holding together, clinging to discipline while waiting for their Alpha to reclaim control.
Then she arrives.
Reyna Voss, a vampire who walks into wolf territory alone, unarmed, unafraid, and far too dangerous to ignore.
She brings a warning of the Hollow, a rogue faction within her kind determined to shatter the fragile truce between wolves and vampires. If they rise unchecked, war will consume both worlds.
An alliance becomes inevitable. Temporary. Strategic.
But nothing about Reyna feels temporary.
The more Axel works with her, the more the line between enemy and ally begins to blur. What grows between them is not trust, it is something darker. Something forbidden. A pull that defies reason and threatens everything they are meant to protect.
With betrayal closing in and war on the horizon, Axel must make a choice: stand by his duty… or give in to a bond that could destroy two kingdoms.…

Zhao Zhitong, who was still in kindergarten, transmigrated to another time with her parents!
As soon as they arrived, their heartless step-grandmother chased them out of the house.
Looking at the only food in their home—two cabbages, Zhao Zhitong's parents wore identical worried looks.
But Zhao Zhitong, with her innocent big eyes, took a bag of rice out from her spatial storage...
So, with her parents, the five-year-old cutie began farming, planting flowers, fruit trees, and herbs. They even opened shops and ran a restaurant...
Life was cozy and satisfying, but it would be even better if there weren't someone who was determined to marry her.
the-interstellar-queen-of-scavengers:
Transported to a garbage-filled planet in the interstellar era, Ji You was so poor she was nearly digging the soil to eat, but... the soil was toxic and inedible... With no other choice, she had to lower her standards and pick up trash and sell scrap, such as these beautiful grass seeds that no one wanted. She gathered them and threaded them into beads to sell online.
But once she posted them online, someone left a negative review: 'Selling grass seeds? Are you crazy for money?'
Days later, this person was pounding the wall in regret: 'I beg you, sell me a grass seed bead, just one! Just one is enough.'
Ji You coldly responded: 'Not selling!'
And then there's the sparkling stones lying all over the streets that nobody wanted. She picked them up, polished them into bracelets, and sold them online.
People lashed out with their words: 'Selling such broken rocks - have you never seen money?'
Days later, those same people were crying and wailing: 'I was blind, I was so shortsighted, to overlook such beautiful and pretty stones. I beg you, sell me one.'
Ji You spread her hands: 'Gone.'
the-reincarnated-sword-hound-of-the-stro:
Nikolai was the most notorious contract killer of the modern world.
Codename: Blood Hound.
A ghost whose name circulated through criminal syndicates, intelligence agencies, and the darkest corners of the underworld. Once he accepted a contract, distance meant nothing, protection meant nothing, and escape was only another way of prolonging the hunt.
His record was nearly flawless.
Ninety-nine percent.
But in the world Nikolai lived in, even the deadliest hound was still a hound and every hound had an owner. After years of unquestioning loyalty, Nikolai was betrayed by the very organization he had killed for. Surrounded, cornered, and ultimately blown apart in an operation designed to erase every trace of his existence, the Blood Hound finally died.
Or so he thought.
When Nikolai opened his eyes again, he was in the body of a five year old child.
His new name was Sigurd Di Zierghardt.
The tenth child of the most terrifying sword clan on the continent.
House Zierghardt.
A family whose name had been carved into history through war and blood.…
the-scumbags-guide-to-heroism:

Waking up as the powerless, orphaned ward in a house of super-powered heroes, with a system interface demanding he get laid to level up? That’s just another day.
He’s the Unmarked son of dead legends, three months from the entrance exam for Halloran Academy. His stats are garbage, his social status is ‘charity case,’ and his only path to power is the Scumbag System.
And the System is a passive-aggressive, trolling interface that offers him reality-bending powers through a gacha mechanic funded by one thing: raising the ‘Temptation Gauges’ of the women around him.
His first quest? It’s to smack the ass of Sloane Fitzgerald—his fiery, super-powered psuedo-sister who sees him as a brother and a pervert in equal measure.
The penalty for failure? A fifty-percent reduction of his manhood. Permanently.
In a California city where heroes are the new celebrities, Lukas must navigate the brutal politics of the super-powered elite, hide a power system nobody can detect, and survive an academy that eats the Unmarked for breakfast.…
the-villains-pov:
“When you think everything is going well, the world will flip you the middle finger.”
__
I had a fantastic life: a loving family, amazing friends, a stable job... I had it all.
But that wasn’t everything—I was also a writer. Writing was my passion, and my novel *'The Land of Survival'* had achieved remarkable success...
Little did I know back then that it would become the very reason my life would be turned upside down. I was reborn inside my own novel, and to make things worse... inside the body of the utterly despised villain, *'Fray.'*
That pathetic villain who dies right at the start. If the novel had 100 possible outcomes, he’d die in 99 of them... and I’m not exaggerating.
But who cares about that? I don’t want this life... I already had everything... Save me the cliché of second chances... because one life is enough for me.
Screw this world, and screw the son of a bitch who brought me here , I’ll find a way back to my world... to my life... no matter what it takes.

In the wake of the apocalypse, betrayal doesn't just stab you in the back—it bites. Zorvax learned this the hard way. Abandoned by those he trusted, he didn't just become another number in the legion of the undead. No, his fate was far more peculiar.
“I thought death was the end... I was wrong,” Zorvax mutters, his voice a gravelly echo of his former self. He's a zombie, but with a twist—he's got his human mind intact. Trapped in a decaying body with an insatiable hunger, Zorvax finds himself in a gruesome predicament that's just the beginning of his ordeal.
Enter the 'Zombolution System,' a mysterious power he awakens that's as cryptic as it is potent. “They wanted a monster?
